synthesis.body: 'FORCE=1 make build-self' projects pack CONTENT into .claude/ and .agents/, but it does not propagate a pack's version. Bumping packs/<pack>/pack.toml alone leaves packs/<pack>/.claude-plugin/plugin.json and the root .claude-plugin/marketplace.json stale. Since agentbundle 0.35.3 the catalogue verifier's CAT-V-005 catches the pack.toml/plugin.json half of that ('make build-check' now fails); marketplace.json staleness is still ungated, and only the agentbundle pytest suite catches it. Bump all three by hand in the same commit.

title: A pack version bump is three files; build-self syncs none of them
